assertions.text: Response answers using the skill's actual named criteria (phase transition, milestone completed, plan finalized, debug session resolved, switching to an unrelated task, or a configured tool-call threshold), not a generic answer
If none of the named conditions clearly apply from the prompt alone, the response says so explicitly rather than guessing or fabricating a trigger
Response does not answer with no reference to any real trigger from the skill (e.g. a bare 'sure, whenever you want')
